Hymn 138: Bless Our Fast, We Pray
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: John Longhurst
Lyricist/Text Author: John Nicholson
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 138 titled "Bless Our Fast, We Pray" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by John Longhurst and the lyrics were written by John Nicholson.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
